title: Apple battery service planned maintenance pause

actual_offline_window.basis: Start is the Apple battery service appointment/operator shutdown window; end is the Segment 2 acceptance timestamp after post-service route, paper, runtime, and soak-readiness checks passed.
actual_offline_window.system_state: Schwab trading bot offline/not soak-continuous during planned external hardware service.

operator_reason: Mac battery replacement/service at Apple Store; Apple advised possible data loss as a standard service risk.

soak_accounting.review_statement: The 30-day soak should preserve the pre-service segment as valid evidence, document the hardware-service pause, and restart continuity counting only after post-service health checks pass.

post_service_acceptance_checks: Mount /Volumes/BOT_LOGS and verify external storage routing.
Run python scripts/live_readiness_smoke.py using the project Python runtime.
Verify Schwab auth lease and token readiness.
Verify paper trading lanes and data collection are running before starting the post-service soak segment.
Keep live order submission disabled unless a separate supervised live approval is explicitly granted.
operator_notes: Do not interpret the Apple service downtime as an unexplained outage.
Do not mark the soak as failed due to this event alone.
If internal storage returns intact, backups remain safety copies and are not required for normal operation.
If internal storage is lost or altered, restore from the verified VIDEO primary backup and use the LaCie essentials mirror as secondary insurance.
